rules.description: Primary brand dark used for default typography, secondary buttons, and striking iconography.
Pure black used for high-contrast section backgrounds, overlays, and primary call-to-action buttons.
when_to_use: Property card badging backgrounds and borders

rules.description: Muted gray utilized for secondary text, metadata, and lower-priority interface elements.
when_to_use: Property card ratings and metadata (beds, nights)

rules.description: The foundational light surface color that serves as the page background and high-contrast text on dark sections.
when_to_use: Inverted text and logos on dark sections (Hero, Wander difference)

rules.description: A dedicated success hue used exclusively to highlight pricing value and deals.
when_to_use: "Less than other sites" savings callouts on property cards

insights: The brand employs an ultra-minimalist, monochromatic strategy that allows rich property photography to stand out as the primary visual focus.
There is a deliberate absence of brand color in the core UI; the only true hue introduced is green, specifically chosen to anchor financial value and savings.
Sophistication is achieved through a heavy reliance on black, white, and varying levels of translucent overlays (e.g., black alpha on badges and hero images) rather than color blocking.
